title: The Jockey Who Won His First Race and Never Got Off Alive #history #shorts
description:
In 1923, stable hand Frank Hayes finally got to ride in a real race: a steeplechase at Belmont Park on his boss's mare, Sweet Kiss. He starved himself to make the weight, and the long shot won. But Frank never got off the horse alive, and nobody knows exactly when his heart stopped.
